7. Scale up the attack: If the target website is able to withstand the initial attack, scale up the traffic being sent to it. This can be done by adding more resources to the attack.

6. Smishing: This involves sending a fraudulent message via text message.
7. Vishing: This involves making a fraudulent phone call.
